scripts.build: npm --workspace functions run build && npm --workspace web run build
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-manitto --only auth,firestore,functions "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.integration.test.mjs"
scripts.test:integration:isolated: npm run build && MANITTO_TEST_AUTH_PORT=9199 MANITTO_TEST_FUNCTIONS_PORT=5101 MANITTO_TEST_FIRESTORE_PORT=8180 firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-manitto --only auth,firestore,functions "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.integration.test.mjs"
scripts.test:rules:isolated: MANITTO_TEST_FIRESTORE_PORT=8180 firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-manitto-rules --only firestore "node --test tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs"
